questions.e: Simple Present માં he/she/it સાથે ક્રિયાપદને -s/-es લાગે છે: She goes. ‘every day’ ટેવ દર્શાવે છે.
‘Look!’ એટલે અત્યારે જ ચાલુ ક્રિયા — Present Continuous: is coming.
‘already’ સાથે Present Perfect (have/has + V3) વપરાય છે: have finished.
‘since 2020’ — ભૂતકાળથી અત્યાર સુધી ચાલુ ક્રિયા: Present Perfect Continuous (has been + V-ing).
‘yesterday’ પૂરો થયેલો ભૂતકાળ બતાવે છે, એટલે Simple Past: watched. Yesterday સાથે have watched ન વપરાય.

questions.q: When I reached the depot, the bus ____.
questions.e: ભૂતકાળની બે ક્રિયામાં જે પહેલાં થઈ તે Past Perfect (had + V3) માં આવે: had already left.

questions.q: They ____ cricket when it started raining.
questions.e: ભૂતકાળમાં ચાલુ ક્રિયા વચ્ચે બીજી ક્રિયા બને ત્યારે ચાલુ ક્રિયા Past Continuous માં આવે: were playing.

questions.q: By next year, she ____ her course.
questions.e: ‘By next year’ — ભવિષ્યના ચોક્કસ સમય પહેલાં પૂરું થશે: Future Perfect (will have + V3).
સનાતન સત્ય (Universal truth) હંમેશાં Simple Present માં લખાય: The sun rises in the east.

questions.q: If it rains, we ____ at home.
questions.e: First Conditional: If + Simple Present, will + V1 → If it rains, we will stay.

questions.q: Which sentence is in the Past Perfect tense?
questions.e: Past Perfect = had + V3. had eaten સાચું છે. has eaten Present Perfect છે.
write – wrote – written. V2 = wrote, V3 = written.
go – went – gone. went ભૂતકાળ (V2) છે.
‘honest’ માં h નો ઉચ્ચાર થતો નથી, શરૂઆત ‘ઓ’ સ્વરથી થાય છે, એટલે an વપરાય.
university નો ઉચ્ચાર ‘યુ’ (વ્યંજન અવાજ)થી થાય છે, એટલે a university. Article અક્ષર પર નહીં, ઉચ્ચાર પર આધારિત છે.
નદી, સમુદ્ર અને પર્વતમાળાનાં નામ પહેલાં The લાગે: The Ganga, The Himalayas.
MLA નો ઉચ્ચાર ‘એમ’ (સ્વર)થી શરૂ થાય છે, તેથી an MLA. એ જ રીતે an MBA, an X-ray.
one નો ઉચ્ચાર ‘વન’ (વ્યંજન ‘વ’)થી થાય છે, તેથી a one-eyed man.
દુનિયામાં એક જ હોય તેવી વસ્તુ પહેલાં The: the sun, the moon, the earth.

questions.q: He is ____ best student in the class.
questions.e: Superlative degree (best, tallest) પહેલાં the લાગે છે.

questions.q: I need ____ hour to finish this job.
questions.e: hour માં h મૌન છે, ઉચ્ચાર ‘અવર’ સ્વરથી — an hour.
સપાટીના ઉપર મૂકેલું હોય તો on.
વર્ષ, મહિનો, ઋતુ સાથે in: in 2005, in May.
ચોક્કસ સમય સાથે at: at 10 o'clock, at noon.
દિવસ અને તારીખ સાથે on: on Monday, on 15 August.
good at / bad at — કોઈ કામ કે વિષયમાં કુશળતા માટે at વપરાય.
ચોક્કસ શરૂઆતના સમય માટે since (since Monday). સમયગાળા માટે for (for two days).

questions.q: I have lived here ____ ten years.

questions.e: ગતિ સાથે બહારથી અંદર જવું હોય તો into. in સ્થિર સ્થિતિ દર્શાવે છે.

questions.q: He divided the sweets ____ the two boys.
questions.e: બે વ્યક્તિ વચ્ચે between, બેથી વધુ વચ્ચે among.
on time = બરાબર નક્કી કરેલા સમયે. in time = સમય પહેલાં / સમયસર પહોંચી જવું.

questions.q: Change into passive: ‘Ravi writes a letter.’
o: A letter is wrote by Ravi.
A letter has written by Ravi.
A letter was written by Ravi.
A letter is written by Ravi.
questions.e: Simple Present passive = is/am/are + V3. writes → is written.

questions.q: Change into passive: ‘The mechanic repaired the engine.’
o: The engine were repaired by the mechanic.
The engine has repaired by the mechanic.
The engine was repaired by the mechanic.
The engine is repaired by the mechanic.
questions.e: Simple Past passive = was/were + V3. repaired → was repaired.

questions.q: Change into passive: ‘They are painting the bus.’
o: The bus has been painted by them.
The bus is being painted by them.
The bus was being painted by them.
The bus is painted by them.
questions.e: Present Continuous passive = is/am/are + being + V3: is being painted. They → by them.

questions.q: Change into passive: ‘She has cleaned the room.’
o: The room has cleaned by her.
The room has been cleaned by her.
The room was cleaned by her.
The room is cleaned by her.
questions.e: Present Perfect passive = has/have + been + V3.

questions.q: Change into passive: ‘He will open the shop.’
o: The shop is opened by him.
The shop will be opened by him.
The shop would be opened by him.
The shop will opened by him.

questions.q: In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the ____.
questions.e: Active નો કર્મ (object) passive માં કર્તા (subject) બને છે, અને મૂળ કર્તા ‘by’ પછી જાય છે.
આજ્ઞાર્થ (Imperative) વાક્યનું passive: Let + object + be + V3.

questions.q: He said, ‘I am tired.’ — Indirect speech:
o: He said that he was tired.
He says that he was tired.
He said that I am tired.
He said that he is tired.
questions.e: Reporting verb ભૂતકાળમાં (said) હોય તો am → was અને I → he થાય.

questions.q: She said to me, ‘Sit down.’ — Indirect speech:
o: She asked that I sit down.
She told me to sit down.
She told me that sit down.
She said me to sit down.
questions.e: આજ્ઞાર્થ વાક્યમાં said to → told/ordered અને to + V1 વપરાય.

questions.q: He said, ‘I will come tomorrow.’ — Indirect speech:
o: He said that I would come tomorrow.
He said that he will come tomorrow.
He told that he will come the next day.
He said that he would come the next day.
questions.e: will → would અને tomorrow → the next day (the following day) થાય.

questions.q: She asked me, ‘Where do you live?’ — Indirect speech:
o: She asked me where did I live.
She asked me where I lived.
She said me where I live.
She asked me where do I live.
questions.e: Wh-પ્રશ્નમાં પ્રશ્નાર્થ ક્રમ હટી જાય: where I lived. do-support નીકળી જાય.

questions.q: He said, ‘Are you ready?’ — Indirect speech:
o: He told whether I was ready.
He asked if I was ready.
He said if I am ready.
questions.e: હા/ના પ્રશ્નમાં if/whether વપરાય અને are → was થાય.

questions.q: The teacher said, ‘The earth moves round the sun.’ — Indirect speech:
o: The teacher said that the earth moves round the sun.
The teacher told the earth moves round the sun.
The teacher said that the earth moved round the sun.
The teacher said that the earth had moved round the sun.
questions.e: સનાતન સત્યમાં Tense બદલાતો નથી, ભલે reporting verb ભૂતકાળમાં હોય.
Brave = બહાદુર. Courageous પણ બહાદુર. Coward (ડરપોક) તેનો વિરોધી છે.
Repair = સમારકામ કરવું = Fix. મિકેનિકની ભાષામાં વારંવાર વપરાતો શબ્દ.
Ancient = પ્રાચીન. તેનો વિરોધી Modern = આધુનિક.
Loose = ઢીલું, Tight = કસેલું. ધ્યાન: Lose (ગુમાવવું) અલગ શબ્દ છે.
Expand = વિસ્તરવું, Contract = સંકોચાવું. ગરમીથી ધાતુ Expand થાય, ઠંડીથી Contract.
Accurate = ચોક્કસ = Exact. માપ સાધનોની ચોકસાઈ માટે Accuracy શબ્દ વપરાય છે.
નિયમ: c પછી ‘ei’ આવે — Receive, Ceiling.
Mechanic — Mech + anic. ITI ટ્રેડનું નામ પણ ખોટું ન લખાય!
Govern + ment = Government. વચ્ચેનો n ભૂલાય નહીં.
Necessary — એક c અને બે s. યાદ: One Collar, two Sleeves.

questions.q: A person who drives a vehicle for others as a job:
questions.e: Driver. વિમાન ચલાવે તે Pilot અને જહાજ પર કામ કરે તે Sailor.

questions.q: A place where buses are kept and repaired:
questions.e: Bus Depot (ડેપો). વિમાન રાખવાની જગ્યા Hangar અને જહાજ માટે Dock.

questions.q: One who cannot read or write:
A list of things to be discussed in a meeting:
questions.e: Agenda = મીટિંગમાં ચર્ચવાના મુદ્દાની યાદી. Minutes = મીટિંગમાં થયેલી ચર્ચાની નોંધ.
Invisible = અદ્રશ્ય. Inaudible = સાંભળી ન શકાય તેવું. Invincible = અજેય.

questions.q: Neither he nor his friends ____ present.
questions.e: Neither...nor માં ક્રિયાપદ નજીકના કર્તા પ્રમાણે: friends (બહુવચન) → were.

questions.q: Each of the students ____ a book.
questions.e: Each એકવચન ગણાય છે, તેથી has.
The number of + બહુવચન → એકવચન ક્રિયાપદ (is). A number of → બહુવચન (are).

questions.q: Bread and butter ____ my favourite breakfast.
questions.e: એક જ વસ્તુ તરીકે વપરાતી જોડી (Bread and butter) એકવચન ગણાય: is.
બે વચ્ચે સરખામણી માટે Comparative: taller than.

questions.q: This is the ____ bus in the depot.

questions.e: he/she/it સાથે નકાર: doesn't + V1 (like, likes નહીં).
Child – Children. Children પોતે જ બહુવચન છે, Childrens ખોટું.
f/fe થી પૂરા થતા શબ્દોમાં ઘણી વાર ves: knife → knives, leaf → leaves.
ક્રિયા કેવી રીતે થઈ તે બતાવે તે Adverb. -ly વાળા ઘણા શબ્દો Adverb હોય છે.

questions.q: In ‘The red bus stopped’, ‘red’ is a/an ____.
Choose the correct question tag: ‘He is a fitter, ____?’
questions.e: હકારાત્મક વાક્ય પછી નકારાત્મક tag: is → isn't he?

questions.q: Choose the correct question tag: ‘They didn't come, ____?’
questions.e: નકારાત્મક વાક્ય પછી હકારાત્મક tag: did they?

questions.q: They ____ in Ahmedabad for ten years.
questions.e: ‘for ten years’ + ભૂતકાળથી અત્યાર સુધી → Present Perfect: have lived.

questions.q: The train ____ before we reached the station.
questions.e: પહેલાં બનેલી ભૂતકાળની ક્રિયા → Past Perfect.
European નો ઉચ્ચાર ‘યુ’ (વ્યંજન) થી — a European.
પવિત્ર ગ્રંથોનાં નામ પહેલાં The: The Gita, The Bible.

questions.q: The cat is hiding ____ the table.
She has been waiting ____ two hours.
Change into passive: ‘The teacher is teaching the students.’
o: The students have been taught by the teacher.
The students are being taught by the teacher.
The students are taught by the teacher.
The students were being taught by the teacher.
questions.e: Present Continuous passive: are + being + V3.

questions.q: He said, ‘I am reading a book.’ — Indirect speech:
o: He said that I am reading a book.
He said that he is reading a book.
He told that he was reading a book.
He said that he was reading a book.
questions.e: am reading → was reading; I → he.

questions.q: Synonym of ‘Repair’ in a workshop context:
questions.e: Overhaul = સંપૂર્ણ તપાસ અને સમારકામ (જેમ કે એન્જિન ઓવરહોલ).
Maintain → Maintenance (ai નહીં, e). સામાન્ય ભૂલ!

questions.q: One who is employed to learn a trade:
questions.e: Apprentice = એપ્રેન્ટિસ (તાલીમાર્થી). ITI પછી ઘણા વિદ્યાર્થી એપ્રેન્ટિસશીપ કરે છે.
Mathematics, Physics, News — આ શબ્દો -s છતાં એકવચન.

o: I has been to Delhi twice.
I have been to Delhi twice.
I have went to Delhi twice.

questions.q: He ____ for two hours when I called him.
questions.e: ભૂતકાળની એક ક્ષણ સુધી ચાલુ ક્રિયા — Past Perfect Continuous.

questions.q: I ____ English for five years now.
questions.e: ‘for five years now’ — Present Perfect Continuous.
ટાઇમટેબલ મુજબ નિશ્ચિત ભવિષ્ય — Simple Present.

questions.q: She ____ the letter before the postman came.
questions.e: બે ભૂતકાળની ક્રિયામાં પહેલી — Past Perfect.

o: I will be waiting at the depot.
I will wait at the depot.
I have waited at the depot.

questions.q: ____ Himalayas are the highest mountains in the world.
The meeting was postponed ____ next week.
The depot is ____ the bus stand and the hospital.
questions.e: બે વચ્ચે — between; ઘણા વચ્ચે — among.

questions.q: She has been suffering ____ fever since Monday.
Change into passive: ‘Who wrote this book?’
o: By whom was this book written?
By whom this book was written?

questions.q: Change into passive: ‘They will finish the work.’
o: The work will finish by them.
The work will be finished by them.
The work is finished by them.
The work would be finished by them.

questions.q: Change into passive: ‘He was repairing the bus.’
o: The bus is being repaired by him.
The bus was repaired by him.
The bus was being repaired by him.
The bus has been repaired by him.
questions.e: Past continuous passive: was/were + being + V3.

questions.q: Change into passive: ‘Somebody has stolen my bicycle.’
o: My bicycle was stolen by somebody has.

questions.q: He said, “I have finished the work.” — Indirect speech:
o: He said that he had finished the work.
He said that I had finished the work.
He said that he has finished the work.
He told that he finished the work.

questions.q: She said, “I can drive.” — Indirect speech:
o: She said that she could drive.
She said that I could drive.
She said that she can drive.

questions.q: He said to me, “Please help me.” — Indirect speech:
o: He said me to help him.
He told that please help him.
He requested me to help him.

questions.q: The officer said, “Don’t smoke here.” — Indirect speech:
o: The officer told not smoke here.
The officer requested to smoke there.
The officer said us don’t smoke here.
The officer forbade us to smoke there.
questions.e: નિષેધ — forbade / told not to; here → there.

questions.q: A person who travels daily to work by bus or train:
A person who is new to a job and still learning:
A government order to stop movement of people at night:

o: Neither of the two buses were available.
Neither of the two buses is available.
Neither of the two buses are available.
Neither of the two bus is available.
questions.e: Neither of + plural noun → singular verb.

questions.q: Either Ravi or his friends ____ responsible.
The committee ____ divided in its opinion.
questions.e: સભ્યો અલગ મત ધરાવે ત્યારે collective noun બહુવચન — are.

questions.q: Choose the correct question tag: ‘Let’s start the engine, ____?’
Choose the correct question tag: ‘Nobody came to the meeting, ____?’
questions.e: Nobody — નકારાત્મક અર્થ; ટેગ હકારાત્મક: did they?

questions.q: The meeting ____ by the time I arrived.
questions.e: પહેલી પૂરી થયેલી ભૂતકાળની ક્રિયા — past perfect.

questions.q: He usually ____ tea in the morning.

questions.q: She said, “Where is the bus stand?” — Indirect:

questions.e: ‘i before e except after c’ — ach-ie-ve.

questions.e: Place used for its main purpose — no article.

questions.e: Abstract noun in general sense — no article.

questions.e: From one side to the other — across.

o: He said that he liked tea.
He said that I liked tea.

questions.q: She said, “I was busy.” — Indirect speech:

questions.q: He said, “I may come.” — Indirect speech:

questions.q: The teacher said to us, “Be quiet.” — Indirect speech:
o: The teacher ordered us that be quiet.
